title: Art. 9.4 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 9 - Passenger Data Exchange Systems, A. General, 9.4
content: Recommended Practice. Contracting States and aircraft operators should provide the appropriate level (where practicable, a 24/7 arrangement) of contact support.
